provenance.membership_authority: Disciplinare di produzione della DOCG «Barolo», Art. 3 (zona di produzione)
provenance.geometry_source: ISTAT — Confini delle unità amministrative a fini statistici (comuni)
provenance.geometry_source_note: PRO_COM codes and polygons are populated by fetch-piedmont-comuni.mjs by exact name-match against the ISTAT comuni layer; they are intentionally null here so the geometry provenance stays with the fetched artifact, not hand-typed.
provenance.geometry_licence: ISTAT open data — CONFIRM exact attribution/redistribution terms during the source spike (owner gate)
provenance.note: Barolo has no national vineyard-parcel layer (unlike France's INAO AOC-VITICOLES); its footprint is derived from member comuni, following the Champagne/Alsace commune model. FIDELITY CAVEAT: comuni 'in parte' (partial) are, in a whole-comune union, over-approximated — some (notably Cherasco and Roddi) contribute only a small sliver of true Barolo land. See footprint_treatment; the higher-fidelity path is the Piemonte Geoportale MGA layer (spec Option C).

footprint_treatment.partial_comuni_policy: included whole at region/appellation display zoom (over-approximation, documented) — flagged for owner review before the DRAFT→VALIDATED flip
footprint_treatment.recommended_review: Owner to decide whether Cherasco/Roddi/Diano d'Alba/Grinzane Cavour are unioned whole or trimmed; MGA geometry (Option C) supersedes this if adopted.
